_comment: KizunaLink (Lavalink v4 node) — Pterodactyl egg for a PREBUILT binary. Download kizunalink-linux-x86_64-musl from the GitHub Releases page, upload it to /home/container/, then start. No Rust toolchain is used. See ../DEPLOYMENT.md.
name: KizunaLink (prebuilt binary)
author: openhands@all-hands.dev
description: KizunaLink — a native Rust Lavalink v4 audio node run from a precompiled Linux binary. The asset kizunalink-linux-x86_64-musl is fully static, so the container needs no C++ compiler, CMake, Cargo or Rustup. Upload the binary to /home/container/ before first start.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# KizunaLink prebuilt-binary installer.
#
# This egg does NOT compile Rust. It only prepares the server volume so the
# uploaded static binary can run. If the static asset is not present yet the
# install still succeeds; upload it via the File Manager and start.
set -e

mkdir -p /mnt/server/logs

# Minimal config.toml if the user has not uploaded one. The panel's KIZUNA_*
# variables override these values at runtime, so the secret is never required
# in the file. Bound to 0.0.0.0 so the panel can route the allocation.
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/config.toml ]; then
    cat > /mnt/server/config.toml <<'EOF'
[server]
address = "0.0.0.0"
port = 2333
authorization = "replace-with-your-strong-secret"

[logging]
level = "info"

[logging.file]
path = "/home/container/logs/kizunalink.log"
max_lines = 10000
max_files = 7
EOF
fi

echo "KizunaLink install complete (prebuilt-binary egg)."
echo "Upload kizunalink-linux-x86_64-musl to /home/container/ if you have not already."

variables.name: Authorization Secret
variables.description: Required. Strong random secret clients use as the Lavalink password. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

variables.name: Bind Address
variables.description: Interface to listen on. Keep 0.0.0.0 so the panel can route the allocation to the process.

variables.name: Port
variables.description: Port to listen on. Must equal the primary allocation port the panel shows for this server.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: trace | debug | info | warn | error | off

variables.name: Rate Limit (per minute)
variables.description: Max REST + WS requests per client IP per minute. 0 disables.

variables.name: Prometheus Metrics
variables.description: Enable the authenticated Prometheus metrics endpoint.
